text: pick up with better tooling to move placed buildings around, and lets get tooltips on the buttons and maybe a some twigs for camera placement so hot updates dont reset it
resolution: Three iso-pane deliverables, all in cart/hmsc-int/IsoAuthor.tsx (+ isoStage.ts). MOVE TOOLING: an unarmed drag that begins on an already-selected piece now moves the whole selection along the active level's ground plane, showing a translucent ghost (blocked-red if invalid) and committing on release as pieceRemoved+piecePlaced per piece — no new pieceMoved stream event (that would touch F2 + compile), the same two events delete/clone already emit; drag on empty ground still rotates the view. TOOLTIPS: every cryptic IsoBtn icon (recenter/rotate/zoom/floor/select-mode/clone/delete) now carries an engine-native hover tooltip via the Pressable tooltip prop (framework/primitive/tooltip.zig). CAMERA TWIGS: the IsoStage pose persists per route through editors/twigs — seeded from the saved pose on mount and written at rest points (rotate/pan key release, wheel, control buttons) so a hot reload restores the view instead of snapping back to the content centroid. Bundles clean.
